items.zh: 老板，能微信支付吗？
items.scene: 小区门口的小超市，你只带了手机

answers.en: Do you take WeChat Pay?
answers.note: take 指商家收不收这种付款方式，问法中性，进店结账时最稳妥。

answers.en: Can I pay with WeChat?
answers.note: 主语换成我，关注自己怎么付，比问商家收不收更随意。

answers.en: WeChat Pay okay?
answers.note: okay 带试探，省掉主语和动词，最短，适合老板正忙、只想确认一句。

items.zh: 我转给你的钱收到了吗？
items.scene: 你刚给室友转了房租，想确认到账没有

answers.en: Did you get the money I transferred?
answers.note: get 指收到，句子短，熟人之间确认小事就用它，不带压力。

answers.en: Did the rent land in your account?
answers.note: land 指钱到账，口语里常说 the money landed，account 指账户，语气轻松。

answers.en: Has my transfer shown up yet?
answers.note: shown up 指钱出现在账户里，yet 暗示可能还没到，带点担心。

items.zh: 这个二维码扫不出来，能再给我看一下吗？
items.scene: 早餐摊付款，收款码怎么扫都没反应

answers.en: I can't scan this QR code. Could you show it to me again?
answers.note: 先说自己扫不出来再请对方出示，中性客气，不把问题推给谁。

answers.en: The code isn't scanning. Mind pulling it up again?
answers.note: Mind doing 是随口请求，pulling it up 指把码调出来，适合聊过两句的摊主。

answers.en: My phone won't read this code. Would you mind showing me the code once more?
answers.note: 把问题归到手机读不出，语气缓和，不想让对方以为码有问题。

items.zh: 我扫了码但钱没扣，是不是没付成功？
items.scene: 超市结账后走出门，手机没弹出扣款通知

answers.en: I scanned the code but nothing was charged. Did the payment go through?
answers.note: nothing was charged 指没扣款，go through 指付款成功，两个点一次问清。

answers.en: It didn't take any money from my account — did that payment fail?
answers.note: 从账户角度说，fail 直接问是不是失败，适合回头找收银员。

answers.en: The payment might not have gone through. Could you check on your end?
answers.note: might not have 留余地，check on your end 请对方查那边，最稳妥。

items.zh: 支付宝微信都行，你方便用哪个？
items.scene: 聚餐后你要还钱给朋友，问他怎么收

answers.en: Alipay or WeChat — whatever's easier.
answers.note: whatever's easier 把决定权直接给对方，句子短，适合熟人还钱。

answers.en: I can do Alipay or WeChat. Which one do you prefer?
answers.note: 完整问句，prefer 稍正式，适合对方是长辈或不太熟的人。

answers.en: Either one works for me. What do you usually use?
answers.note: 问对方平时用哪个，而不是当下方便，适合第一次给他转钱。

items.zh: 这个月花呗账单有点多，能分期吗？
items.scene: 你在支付宝里看到还款金额，找客服

answers.en: My Huabei bill is a bit high this month. Can I pay it in installments?
answers.note: 保留 Huabei 原词，installments 指分期还款，问客服时最清楚。

answers.en: Is there a way to split this month's Huabei payment into smaller chunks?
answers.note: split into smaller chunks 指把还款拆成几笔，比 installments 口语。

answers.en: Money's a little tight this month. Can I set up a payment plan for my Huabei bill?
answers.note: money's tight 指手头紧，payment plan 指分期方案，语气坦诚。

items.zh: 老板，你们收现金吗？
items.scene: 老式菜市场，你身上只有一张一百的纸币

answers.en: Do you accept cash?
answers.note: accept 比 take 稍正式，问法完整，适合先确认再挑东西。

answers.en: Cash okay?
answers.note: 两个词的口语问法，带试探，摊主正忙时抬头问一句就行。

answers.en: I only have cash on me. Is that all right?
answers.note: 先说明自己只有现金，再问行不行，语气客气，带一点歉意。

items.zh: 我没带现金，扫码付行吗？
items.scene: 路边买烤红薯，摊主说找零不方便

answers.en: I don't have any cash on me. Can I scan to pay?
answers.note: scan to pay 指扫码付款，先讲情况再请求，小摊和商店都通用。

answers.en: I didn't bring cash — is paying by QR code okay?
answers.note: 用 QR code 代指扫码，is ... okay 带商量，适合对方刚说找零麻烦。

answers.en: Sorry, I left my wallet at home. Would you mind if I paid by QR code?
answers.note: 先道歉再说没带钱包，Would you mind if 最客气，适合对方已经不太乐意时。

items.zh: 能给我换点零钱吗？这张一百的找不开。
items.scene: 公交站小卖部，你想换零钱坐车

answers.en: Can you break a hundred? I need some change.
answers.note: break a hundred 是把一百块破开的固定说法，美国日常常用。

answers.en: Could you give me change for a hundred? I can't use this on the bus.
answers.note: change for a hundred 更完整，补一句用途，店员更愿意帮。

answers.en: Any chance you could break this hundred for me? I'm short on change.
answers.note: Any chance 让请求更软，short on change 指缺零钱，适合怕被拒绝。

items.zh: 差的两块我扫码补给你吧？
items.scene: 你买水果付现金，老板抽屉里没零钱

answers.en: Let me just scan to pay the two yuan I still owe you.
answers.note: owe 指还欠着，scan to pay 指扫码补付，直接给方案，最省事。

answers.en: Want me to send you the rest on WeChat?
answers.note: on WeChat 指微信转账，the rest 指剩下的钱，随意，适合年轻老板。

answers.en: I can pay the difference with my phone if that's easier.
answers.note: pay the difference 指补差价，if that's easier 给对方台阶，语气客气。

items.zh: 这顿饭咱们AA吧，谁也别抢。
items.scene: 三个朋友吃完火锅，账单放在桌子中间

answers.en: Let's split the bill.
answers.note: split the bill 是最通用的 AA 说法，不说金额，三个人也能用。

answers.en: Let's split it three ways.
answers.note: three ways 明确按三份分，人数一说清就不会算错。

answers.en: How about we just divide it evenly?
answers.note: divide it evenly 强调平均分，大家吃得差不多时最省事，先把规则说清。

items.zh: 咱们各付各的吧，按自己点的算。
items.scene: 同事聚餐，有人只点了沙拉和饮料

answers.en: Can we get separate checks?
answers.note: separate checks 指分开结账，美式餐厅标准说法，直接对服务员说。

answers.en: Could we split this by what each person ordered?
answers.note: 按各自点的分，比均摊精确，适合有人点得贵时。

answers.en: Let's just pay for our own orders.
answers.note: our own orders 指自己点的那份，最口语，适合熟人之间商量。

items.zh: 我手机没电了，你先帮我付一下，回头还你。
items.scene: 便利店结账时手机自动关机，朋友排在后面

answers.en: My phone just died. Can you cover me? I'll pay you back.
answers.note: phone died 指手机关机，cover me 指先替我付，pay you back 说会还。

answers.en: My phone's dead — could you spot me? I'll get you back later.
answers.note: spot me 是口语里借我垫一下，get you back later 比 pay back 随意。

answers.en: My battery's dead. Would you mind paying for me? I'll pay you back tonight.
answers.note: 最客气，battery's dead 说明原因，tonight 给出明确还钱时间。

items.zh: 你的外卖我先付了，一共三十八。
items.scene: 中午帮同事一起点外卖，餐到了你提醒他

answers.en: I paid for your takeout — it came to thirty-eight.
answers.note: 先说自己付了再报数，把话递到对方那儿，同事之间最常用。

answers.en: Your takeout was thirty-eight. Mind sending it over when you get a sec?
answers.note: 直接开口要钱，Mind sending it over 很口语，适合关系近的同事。

answers.en: I covered your takeout — it was thirty-eight in total. No rush.
answers.note: covered 指我付过了，No rush 表示不急着还，适合对方正忙时。

items.zh: 这杯我请，别跟我抢。
items.scene: 同事帮你顶了班，下班后你请他喝奶茶

answers.en: This one's on me — don't argue.
answers.note: don't argue 半开玩笑堵住对方，适合关系好的同事，语气爽快。

answers.en: I'm buying this round. No arguments.
answers.note: buying this round 原指请一轮酒，也用于奶茶，No arguments 更强势。

answers.en: Let me treat you. You had my back today.
answers.note: treat you 指请客，had my back 指帮我顶住，语气温和，适合认真道谢。

items.zh: 服务员，麻烦买单。
items.scene: 商场餐厅里，你们吃完准备赶电影

answers.en: Can we get the check, please?
answers.note: 美式餐厅说 check 最地道，please 是基本礼貌，举手招呼时用。

answers.en: Check, please.
answers.note: 两个词最省事，服务员一听就懂，适合人多嘈杂、赶时间。

answers.en: Could we have the check when you get a chance?
answers.note: when you get a chance 表示不催，服务员正忙时用，客气又留余地。

items.zh: 这个月电费怎么这么高？
items.scene: 收到电力公司短信账单，比上月多了一倍

answers.en: Why is the electric bill so high this month?
answers.note: electric bill 指电费单，直接问原因，适合先跟室友开口。

answers.en: How did the electric bill jump this much?
answers.note: jump 指突然上涨，比 is high 更强调涨幅，带惊讶。

answers.en: Is it just me, or did the electric bill double this month?
answers.note: Is it just me 是缓和质问的开头，double 指翻倍，不想显得指责。

items.zh: 你帮我看看这账单，是不是多收我钱了？
items.scene: 话费账单多了六十块，你把截图发给朋友

answers.en: Can you look at this bill? I think they overcharged me.
answers.note: overcharged 指多收钱，直接说出怀疑，适合请朋友帮忙核对。

answers.en: Does this bill look off to you? I feel like I got charged too much.
answers.note: look off 指看着不对劲，feel like 语气不确定，比 overcharged 软。

answers.en: Could you double-check this bill for me? Something doesn't add up.
answers.note: double-check 指再核对，doesn't add up 指账对不上，适合认真查。

items.zh: 咱们这个月账单是不是超支了？
items.scene: 月底你和伴侣对着记账软件算开销

answers.en: Did we go over budget this month?
answers.note: go over budget 指超支，最常用，适合两口子日常对账。

answers.en: Are we over budget for the month?
answers.note: be over budget 是状态，像在确认现状，比 did we go over 平。

answers.en: Have we blown through our budget this month?
answers.note: blow through 指把钱花光，语气夸张带自嘲，适合气氛轻松时。

items.zh: 这个会员怎么取消自动续费啊？
items.scene: 视频网站又扣了会员费，你在家庭群里问

answers.en: How do I turn off auto-renewal for this membership?
answers.note: turn off 指关掉，auto-renewal 是自动续费，问法清楚，适合问朋友。

answers.en: Where's the option to cancel auto-renew?
answers.note: 问选项在哪，说明自己在设置里找不到，比 how do I 更具体。

answers.en: Does anyone know how to stop this membership from renewing itself?
answers.note: renewing itself 把自动续费说成自己续，带无奈，适合群里求助。

items.zh: 我忘了取消试用，结果被扣钱了。
items.scene: 你跟同事抱怨修图软件自动扣了年费

answers.en: I forgot to cancel the free trial, and they charged me.
answers.note: 陈述事实，charged me 指被扣钱，语气平，适合顺口抱怨。

answers.en: I missed the trial deadline and got billed for a whole year.
answers.note: missed the deadline 指错过期限，got billed 偏账单说法，强调损失一年。

answers.en: The trial rolled over into a paid plan because I forgot to cancel — I'm so annoyed.
answers.note: rolled over into 指试用到期自动转成付费，I'm so annoyed 直接表达懊恼。

items.zh: 这个东西我不想要了，能退款吗？
items.scene: 网购台灯尺寸不对，你联系客服

answers.en: I don't want this anymore. Can I get a refund?
answers.note: 先说要退再问退款，直接清楚，适合给在线客服发消息。

answers.en: I'd like to return this for a refund, please.
answers.note: return ... for a refund 是退货退款的标准说法，礼貌正式，适合打电话。

answers.en: Is this eligible for a refund? It's the wrong size.
answers.note: eligible for 指够不够退款条件，先问规则再讲原因，适合怕被拒。

items.zh: 退款都三天了还没到，能帮我查一下吗？
items.scene: 退掉的鞋已寄回，钱还没到账，你催客服

answers.en: It's been three days and my refund still hasn't arrived. Can you check?
answers.note: still hasn't arrived 强调还没到，催得明确但不过火，适合客服窗口。

answers.en: Could you look into my refund? It's been three days.
answers.note: look into 指帮忙查，先请求再补时间，比直接抱怨客气。

answers.en: I still haven't gotten my refund after three days. What's going on?
answers.note: What's going on 带明显不满，适合已经问过一次还没解决。

items.zh: 能给我开张发票吗？公司报销要用。
items.scene: 出差住酒店退房，你在前台结账

answers.en: Could I get an invoice for this? I need it for reimbursement.
answers.note: invoice 指正式发票，reimbursement 指报销，前台一听就明白。

answers.en: Can you issue a receipt for reimbursement?
answers.note: issue 是开具，receipt 偏收据，说法正式，适合商务场合。

answers.en: Can I get a detailed invoice? My company needs it for reimbursement.
answers.note: detailed 指要明细，公司财务常要求列清项目，适合报销审核严时。

items.zh: 发票抬头写我们公司名字。
items.scene: 打印店结账，店员问发票怎么开

answers.en: Put my company's name on the invoice, please.
answers.note: put ... on 指把名字写在发票上，最直接，店员照做就行。

answers.en: Could you make the invoice out to my company?
answers.note: make out to 是开票据抬头的固定说法，比 put on 更专业。

answers.en: It's for my company, so the invoice needs our company name on it.
answers.note: 先讲用途再提要求，把原因说清，店员更不容易写错。
